# Method

This study has a 2 x 2 mixed design. 

* Each pair was randomly assigned to either the first-person request condition or to third-person request condition.

* Two participants in each pair was randomly assigned to either the Perspective of Requester (or "Beneficiary") or the Perspective of Helper.

```{r, echo=FALSE, message= FALSE, warning= FALSE}

setwd("/Users/xuanzhao/Dropbox/Zhao Epley Happy to Help/OSF documents/Study 5/")
data_folder <- "/Users/xuanzhao/Dropbox/Zhao Epley Happy to Help/OSF documents/Study 5/"
file <- "Study 5 data.csv"

```

```{r, echo=FALSE, message= FALSE, warning= FALSE}

hhh5_data_all <- read_csv(paste0(data_folder,file))
hhh5_data_all$Pair_ID <- as.factor(hhh5_data_all$Pair_ID)
```

## Participants

Total pairs of participants:

```{r, echo=FALSE, message= FALSE, warning= FALSE}

table(hhh5_data_all$Condition)

```

What happened in the study?

```{r, echo=FALSE, message= FALSE, warning= FALSE}

table(hhh5_data_all$include, hhh5_data_all$Condition)

```

The following pairs were excluded from data analysis due to:

**Experimenter error:**

* No.51 (First-person request): The experimenter accidentally gave the person who was supposed to be the helper *more* pages than the beneficiary.

**Confused participants:**

* No.23 (Third-person request): Helper--"This test was weird.  I could not understand why I was given the other person's sheet."

* No.64 (First-person request): Beneficiary said the Helper agreed to Help, but the Helper said they did not receive a request from the Beneficiary or did not agree, and they did not help. Experimenter note: "Person A might not have understood the full instructions of the task because she mentioned that she had more pages than the other person at the end of the study."

* No.82 (First-person request): Experimenter--"Session was terminated early. Participants started the full counting task early on two separate occasions after being told that they would receive explicit instructions as to when to start."

* No.84 (First-person request): Experimenter--"Person A let the researcher now that Person B had been cheating, filling out sheets during the survey and then placing them back in the folder before the experimenter came back in."

<br>

## Procedure

### Pre-request surveys

Before the request was made

* Measures on the **beneficiary's side**:

    * *Predicted* helper's Willingness & Discomfort to say no & Motivation & Positive mood & Perceived inconvenience

    * Self Positive Mood

* Measures on the **helper's side**:

    * Self Positive Mood


### Post-request surveys

Immediately after the request was made, before help was performed.

* Measures on the **beneficiary's side**:

    * The helper's agreement: Yes/No

    * *Perceived* helper's Willingness & Discomfort to say no

* Measures on the **helper's side**:

    * Willingness & Discomfort to say no & Motivation

### Post-helping surveys

* Measures on the **beneficiary's side**:

    + Self Positive Mood & Gratefulness & Indebtedness

    + *Perceived* helper's Positive Mood & Perceived inconvenience

* Measures on the **helper's side**:

    * Positive Mood & Perceived inconvenience

    * Prediction on beneficiary's Gratefulness & Indebtedness

<br>

# Before request

**Let's ONLY exclude those 5 pairs who experienced experimenter error or confusion in the study** 

```{r, echo=FALSE, message= FALSE, warning= FALSE}

hhh5_data_all <- hhh5_data_all %>%
  filter(include != "No_procedure_confusion") %>%
  filter(include != "No_procedure") %>%
  filter(include != "No_experimenter_error")

```


## Miscalibration: Beneficiary vs. Helper

### Willing to help

```{r, echo=FALSE, message= FALSE, warning= FALSE}

cor.test(hhh5_data_all$willing_pre_A, hhh5_data_all$interested_pre_A)
cor.test(hhh5_data_all$willing_B, hhh5_data_all$interested_B)

hhh5_willing <- hhh5_data_all %>%
  dplyr::select(Pair_ID, Condition, willing_pre_A, willing_B) %>%
  gather(Perspective, willing, -Pair_ID, -Condition) %>%
  mutate(Perspective = factor(Perspective, levels = c("willing_pre_A", "willing_B"), labels = c("Help-Seeker", "Helper"))) 

hhh5_interest <- hhh5_data_all %>%
  dplyr::select(Pair_ID, Condition, interested_pre_A, interested_B) %>%
  gather(Perspective, interest, -Pair_ID, -Condition) %>%
  mutate(Perspective = factor(Perspective, levels = c("interested_pre_A", "interested_B"), labels = c("Help-Seeker", "Helper"))) 
  
hhh5_willingness <- hhh5_willing
hhh5_willingness$interest <- hhh5_interest$interest
hhh5_willingness$willingness <- (hhh5_willingness$willing + hhh5_willingness$interest)/2

ggbarplot(hhh5_willingness, x = "Perspective", y = "willingness", add = "mean_se", 
          color = "black", fill = "Perspective", alpha = 0.75, 
          facet.by = "Condition", 
          palette = c("#767676","#181818"), 
          position = position_dodge(0.8)) +
  xlab("") + 
  ylab("Willingness to help") + 
  rremove("x.text") + 
  font("xlab", size = 12) +
  font("x.text", size = 12) +
  font("ylab", size = 12) + 
  coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0,10))+
  font("legend.title", size = 12) +
  font("legend.text", size = 12) +
  scale_y_continuous(breaks=seq(0,10,2))

# ggsave("hhh5_willingness.pdf", plot = last_plot(), device = "pdf", width = 5, height = 3.5, dpi = 300)

anova_result <- summary(aov(willingness ~ Condition * Perspective + Error(Pair_ID/Perspective), data = hhh5_willingness))
print(anova_result)

between_square <- anova_result[1][[1]][[1]][,2]
within_square <- anova_result[2][[1]][[1]][,2]

#Partial eta-square of between-subject factor (Condition)
between_square[1]/(between_square[1] + between_square[2])

#Partial eta-square of within-subject factor (Perspective)
within_square[1]/(within_square[1] + within_square[3])

#Partial eta-square of interaction term (Perspective:Condition)
within_square[2]/(within_square[2] + within_square[3])


lower_ci <- function(mean, se, n, conf_level = 0.95){
  lower_ci <- mean - qt(1 - ((1 - conf_level) / 2), n - 1) * se
}

ddply(hhh5_willingness, c("Perspective"), summarise,
               N    = length(willingness),
               mean = mean(willingness, na.rm = TRUE),
               sd   = sd(willingness, na.rm = TRUE),
               se   = sd / sqrt(N), 
               ci = mean - lower_ci(mean, se, N))

effsize::cohen.d(willingness ~ Perspective, paired=TRUE, data = hhh5_willingness)

```

### Discomfort rejecting request

# After helping

**Now, let's exclude requesters who did not ask for help.** 

```{r, echo=FALSE, message= FALSE, warning= FALSE}

hhh5_data <- hhh5_data_all %>%
  filter(include != 'No_A did not ask') 

```


**Let's further exclude the pair in which the helper declined to help.**

**We will keep those pairs in which the helper agreed to help but after 5-minute counting task, failed to actually help, or helped the other but didn't finish their own task**

```{r, echo=FALSE, message= FALSE, warning= FALSE}

hhh5_data <- hhh5_data %>%
  filter(include != 'No_B declined')

```

# Mood Change: Before vs. After

* Happiness measures may be confounded in this study, because helpers can get happy because they win the bonus, too. (The experimenter announces that both gets bonus)


```{r, echo=FALSE, message= FALSE, warning= FALSE}

hhh5_data$posmood_A_pre_self <- (hhh5_data$self_positive_pre_A + hhh5_data$self_pleased_pre_A + 5)/2
hhh5_data$posmood_A_post_self <- (hhh5_data$self_positive_post_A + hhh5_data$self_pleased_post_A + 5)/2

hhh5_data_self_change <- hhh5_data 

hhh5_A_self_change <- hhh5_data %>%
  select(Pair_ID, Condition, posmood_A_pre_self, posmood_A_post_self) %>%
  gather(Person, A_mood, -Pair_ID, -Condition) %>%
  mutate(Person = factor(Person, levels = c("posmood_A_pre_self", "posmood_A_post_self"), labels = c("Before", "After"))) 

hhh5_data$posmood_B_pre <- (hhh5_data$positive_pre_B + hhh5_data$please_pre_B + 5)/2

hhh5_data_self_change_short <- hhh5_data %>%
  select(Pair_ID, Condition, posmood_A_pre_self, posmood_A_post_self, posmood_B_pre, posmood_B)
write.csv(hhh5_data_self_change_short, "moodchange.csv")

hhh5_B_self_change <- hhh5_data %>%
  select(Pair_ID, Condition, posmood_B_pre, posmood_B) %>%
  gather(Person, B_mood, -Pair_ID, -Condition) %>%
  mutate(Person = factor(Person, levels = c("posmood_B_pre", "posmood_B"), labels = c("Before", "After"))) 

hhh5_self_change <- left_join(hhh5_A_self_change, hhh5_B_self_change, by = c("Person", "Pair_ID", "Condition"))

hhh5_self_change_long <- hhh5_self_change %>%
  select(Pair_ID, Condition, Person, A_mood, B_mood) %>%
  gather(Time, self_mood, -Pair_ID, -Condition, -Person) %>%
  mutate(Time = factor(Time, levels = c("A_mood", "B_mood"), labels = c("Help-Seeker", "Helper"))) 

ggbarplot(hhh5_self_change_long, x = "Person", y = "self_mood", facet.by = "Condition", 
          add = "mean_se", 
          color = "Time", fill = "Time", 
          alpha = 0.75, 
          palette = c("#808080","#181818"), 
          position = position_dodge(0.8)) +
  xlab("") + 
  ylab("Mood Change") + 
  rremove("x.text") + 
  font("xlab", size = 12) +
  font("x.text", size = 12) +
  font("ylab", size = 12) + 
  coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0,10))+
  font("legend.title", size = 12) +
  font("legend.text", size = 12) +
  scale_y_continuous(breaks=seq(0,10,2))

# ggsave("hhh6_mood_comparison.pdf", plot = last_plot(), device = "pdf", width = 5, height = 3.5, dpi = 300)


ddply(hhh5_self_change_long, c("Person", "Time"), summarise,
               N    = length(self_mood),
               mean = mean(self_mood),
               sd   = sd(self_mood),
               se   = sd / sqrt(N))

```

## Requesters' experiences

### Feeling grateful

```{r, echo=FALSE, message= FALSE, warning= FALSE}

hhh5_grateful <- hhh5_data %>%
  select(Pair_ID, Condition, grateful_A, grateful_B) %>%
  gather(Perspective, grateful, -Pair_ID, -Condition) %>%
  mutate(Perspective = factor(Perspective, levels = c("grateful_A", "grateful_B"), labels = c("Beneficiary Actual", "Helper Predicted"))) 

ggbarplot(hhh5_grateful, x = "Perspective", y = "grateful", add = "mean_se", 
          color = "black", fill = "Perspective", alpha = 0.75, 
          facet.by = "Condition", 
          palette = c("#767676","#181818"), 
          position = position_dodge(0.8)) +
  xlab("") + 
  ylab("Feeling Grateful") + 
  rremove("x.text") + 
  font("xlab", size = 12) +
  font("x.text", size = 12) +
  font("ylab", size = 12) + 
  coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0,10))+
  font("legend.title", size = 12) +
  font("legend.text", size = 12) +
  scale_y_continuous(breaks=seq(0,10,2))

# ggsave("hhh5_prosocial.pdf", plot = last_plot(), device = "pdf", width = 5, height = 3.5, dpi = 300)


anova_result <- summary(aov(grateful ~ Condition * Perspective + Error(Pair_ID/Perspective), data = hhh5_grateful))
print(anova_result)

between_square <- anova_result[1][[1]][[1]][,2]
within_square <- anova_result[2][[1]][[1]][,2]

#Partial eta-square of between-subject factor (Condition)
between_square[1]/(between_square[1] + between_square[2])

#Partial eta-square of within-subject factor (Perspective)
within_square[1]/(within_square[1] + within_square[3])

#Partial eta-square of interaction term (Perspective:Condition)
within_square[2]/(within_square[2] + within_square[3])


ddply(hhh5_grateful, c("Perspective"), summarise,
               N    = length(grateful),
               mean = mean(grateful),
               sd   = sd(grateful),
               se   = sd / sqrt(N))

```

# Exploratory analysis

### Perceived Willingness (after request)

```{r, echo=FALSE, message= FALSE, warning= FALSE}

hhh5_willing_3 <- hhh5_data_all %>%
  select(Pair_ID, Condition, willing_pre_A, willing_post_A, willing_B) %>%
  gather(Measure, willing, -Pair_ID, -Condition) %>%
  mutate(Measure = factor(Measure, levels = c("willing_pre_A", "willing_post_A", "willing_B"), labels = c("Help-Seeker (Initial)", "Help-Seeker (Update)", "Helper"))) 

hhh5_interest_3 <- hhh5_data_all %>%
  select(Pair_ID, Condition, interested_pre_A, interested_post_A, interested_B) %>%
  gather(Measure, interest, -Pair_ID, -Condition) %>%
  mutate(Measure = factor(Measure, levels = c("interested_pre_A", "interested_post_A", "interested_B"), labels = c("Help-Seeker (Initial)", "Help-Seeker (Update)", "Helper"))) 
  

hhh5_willingness_3 <- hhh5_willing_3
hhh5_willingness_3$interest <- hhh5_interest_3$interest
hhh5_willingness_3$willingness <- (hhh5_willingness_3$willing + hhh5_willingness_3$interest)/2


ggbarplot(hhh5_willingness_3, x = "Measure", y = "willingness", add = "mean_se", 
          color = "black", fill = "Measure", alpha = 0.75, 
          facet.by = "Condition", 
          palette = c("#767676", "#FFFFFF","#181818"), 
          position = position_dodge(0.8)) +
  xlab("") + 
  ylab("Willingness to help") + 
  rremove("x.text") + 
  font("xlab", size = 12) +
  font("x.text", size = 12) +
  font("ylab", size = 12) + 
  coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0,10))+
  font("legend.title", size = 12) +
  font("legend.text", size = 12) +
  scale_y_continuous(breaks=seq(0,10,2))

ggsave("hhh5_willingness_new.pdf", plot = last_plot(), device = "pdf", width = 5, height = 3.5, dpi = 300)


anova_model <- aov(willingness ~ Condition * Measure + Error(Pair_ID/Measure), data = hhh5_willingness_3)
print(summary(anova_model))

between_square <- anova_result[1][[1]][[1]][,2]
within_square <- anova_result[2][[1]][[1]][,2]

#Partial eta-square of between-subject factor (Condition)
between_square[1]/(between_square[1] + between_square[2])

#Partial eta-square of within-subject factor (Perspective)
within_square[1]/(within_square[1] + within_square[3])

#Partial eta-square of interaction term (Perspective:Condition)
within_square[2]/(within_square[2] + within_square[3])

ddply(hhh5_willingness_3, c("Measure"), summarise,
               N    = length(willingness),
               mean = mean(willingness),
               sd   = sd(willingness),
               se   = sd / sqrt(N))

#Pairwise comparison:
# 
# anova_emm <- emmeans(anova_model, ~ Measure)
# pairs(anova_emm)


hhh5_willingness_1 <- hhh5_willingness_3 %>%
  filter(Measure != "Helper")
t.test(willingness ~ Measure, data = hhh5_willingness_1, var.equal = TRUE, alternative = "two.sided", paired = TRUE)

hhh5_willingness_2 <- hhh5_willingness_3 %>%
  filter(Measure != "Help-Seeker (Initial)")
t.test(willingness ~ Measure, data = hhh5_willingness_2, var.equal = TRUE, alternative = "two.sided", paired = TRUE)

```

### Mediation analysis

See SPSS syntax.

```{r, echo=FALSE, message= FALSE, warning= FALSE}

hhh5_data$willingness_A <- (hhh5_data$willing_pre_A + hhh5_data$interested_pre_A)/2
hhh5_data$willingness_B <- (hhh5_data$willing_B + hhh5_data$interested_B)/2

hhh5_data$prosocial_A <- (hhh5_data$motivation_pre_A_r_1 + hhh5_data$motivation_pre_A_r_2)/2
hhh5_data$prosocial_B <- (hhh5_data$motivation_B_1 + hhh5_data$motivation_B_2)/2

hhh5_data$compliance_A <- (hhh5_data$motivation_pre_A_r_3 + hhh5_data$motivation_pre_A_r_4)/2
hhh5_data$compliance_B <- (hhh5_data$motivation_B_3 + hhh5_data$motivation_B_4)/2


hhh5_data_spss <- hhh5_data %>%
  select(Condition, willingness_A, posmood_A_pre, inc_A_pre, prosocial_A, compliance_A, willingness_B, posmood_B, inc_B, prosocial_B, compliance_B)

write.csv(hhh5_data_spss, "hhh5_data_spss.csv")

```
